entries.name: Home Assistant
entries.description: See what's happening in your home and control it.

fields.label: Address of your tool server
fields.help: The full address. Home Assistant's own ends in /api/mcp, and an add-on shows its own.

fields.label: Access token, if it needs one
fields.help: In Home Assistant, open your profile, then Security, and create a long-lived token there.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: Work with repositories, issues, pull requests and code on GitHub.

fields.label: Access token
fields.help: In GitHub, open Settings, then Developer settings, and create a personal access token there.
